title: Development of edible food coating using cassava starch/agar blends infused with clove oil for the preservation of mangoes
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,533-546
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00409H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
David Rohindra, Reeha Sharma, Roselyn Lata, Tejesvi Patel
The study developed biodegradable edible food coatings using cassava starch, agar, glycerol and clove oil (CO). The coatings sped up the drying process, with CO adding antimicrobial and insect-repellent properties.
